title: Numerical Methods in Engineering
description:
Jointly offered with: ENME417.
Credit only granted for: ENME745, ENME808B, ENME417 or ENME489J.
Formerly: ENME808B. Fundamental aspects of how to apply analytical mathematical concepts to discrete data. The course is aimed at graduate students in any area of engineering, and treats the material in a general manner that is not specific to any application or field of specialization.
